description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the California Codes — California state statutes — by citation. "Penal Code 187" is code "PEN", section "187". Returns the statutory text, where it sits in the code, and when it was last amended. Keyless. Use for "what does California Penal Code 187 say", "text of California Civil Code 1542", or to check a California statute a contract or case relies on.

code.description: California code abbreviation, e.g. "PEN" (Penal), "CIV" (Civil), "VEH" (Vehicle), "LAB" (Labor). Call ca_codes to see all 29.

section.description: Section number as cited, e.g. "187" or "1542". Subdivisions like "187(a)" are not separate documents — pass the section.

name: ca_code_section
